study: Do posted GPU price indices measure repricing or observation-basket change?
status: Frozen before any decomposition, transition count or outcome computation; schema, two non-price sample rows per collector, target source counts and existing literature/results inspected first.
question: How much of observed adjacent-day movement in the 37 scored posted-rental median indices is attributable to changing observed contract membership or row sampling, rather than movement in matched observed contract cells?

hypotheses.H_price: Matched-cell movement dominates: non-repricing absolute-component share F <= 0.20.
hypotheses.H_mixed: Neither dominance claim is supported, or result depends materially on source or matching definition.

data: Unmodified Pacific gpu-price-pack-v0.1.1-handover rental_observations parquet and daily_statistics.csv; no network or new data. 37 rows in existing data/targets.csv. Primary endpoint dates 2026-07-10 through 2026-11-06 with both adjacent dates observed and earliest input 2026-07-09, avoiding known early-July backfill. No filling gaps. Exclude no source within the target cohort. Broader population or forecast promotion is out of scope.

key.nulls: Explicit null is a reproducible category, not evidence of identical unobserved quality. Never infer missing SKU, memory or region.
key.sensitivity_coarse: same primary key with sku_raw and all extra_json attributes removed; retain other published contract fields
key.sensitivity_raw_provider: primary key but provider_raw replaces normalized provider
key.daily_cell_price: Median of all observed rows in that key/day; do not use row count as weight for cell median index. Record within-key same-snapshot distinct-price conflicts and missing SKU/count/region.
key.interpretation: Matched observable contract cell, not verified identical executable offer. FastGPU cells are daily minima, not individual offers. Different collectors never pooled into a single price index.

decomposition.A: Median over all raw rows of one target/day, unrounded; verify round(A,4) equals supplied daily_statistics median to rounding tolerance.
decomposition.E: Unweighted median of daily cell prices over all keys that day.
decomposition.M: Unweighted median of daily cell prices restricted to keys present on both adjacent days.
decomposition.sampling_S: log(A_new/E_new)-log(A_old/E_old); includes multiplicity and within-cell aggregation, not pure sampling causality
decomposition.identity: D = S + C + R to floating-point tolerance. C is an overlap-bridge residual, not a causal effect or a unique index-number attribution.
decomposition.no_overlap: Report as unidentified; never assign all movement to membership or repricing.
decomposition.high_overlap: At least 3 common keys and common/old >= .8 and common/new >= .8; report separately, not substitute for primary.
decomposition.unchanged: Retain all transitions, including zero aggregate change, because opposing components may cancel. Material-change diagnostic: abs(D)>=log(1.01).

primary_metric: F = (sum abs(S) + sum abs(C)) / (sum abs(S)+sum abs(C)+sum abs(R)), over all identifiable adjacent-day target transitions. Components measured in log units. This is share of absolute bridge components, NOT percent of observed net change explained. Also report net motion sum abs(D), cancellation, source/series shares, count with zero matched change and nonzero index change, no-overlap coverage and fraction of total raw absolute movement retained.

statistical_tests.bootstrap: 2000 draws, numpy seed 20261115. Resample whole fixed 7-calendar-day endpoint blocks starting 2026-07-10, preserving all series and days within each block, including final partial block. Percentile 95% CI for F. Descriptive dependent-panel inference; no claim of untouched holdout or randomized causal identification.
statistical_tests.decision: Support H_basket only if lower CI > .50; support H_price only if upper CI < .20; otherwise inconclusive/mixed. Report all prespecified key sensitivities and leave-one-source-out estimates. A conclusion that reverses across keys or removal of a source is explicitly source/key-dependent.
statistical_tests.multiplicity: One primary metric/test only. All subgroup, high-overlap, 1% move, and sensitivity statistics are diagnostic, not extra independent tests or selectable winning claims.

controls: Synthetic fixed prices with changing membership: R=0 and all motion S+C.
Synthetic fixed membership, uniform 10% repricing: S=C=0 and R=log(1.1).
Synthetic changing multiplicity only: C=R=0 and all motion S.
Synthetic offsetting membership and repricing with unchanged raw median exposes cancellation.
Synthetic missing-day gap never becomes adjacent-day transition.
Rows reordered or observation IDs changed cannot alter keys or outputs.
Primary decomposition identity, stable-basket C=0, raw median reconciliation, cutoff and protected-file hashes checked.

Independent implementation reconstructs deterministic highest-motion cases from original parquet and validates summary against persisted transitions; review separates observed-cell change from proven repricing.
deliverables: Frozen protocol and hash, standalone scripts, daily-cell derived data, every transition and bootstrap draw, coverage/provenance report, deterministic event raw rows with source provenance, synthetic tests, independent verification, readable report with negatives and discovery chain. All writes only research/frontier_20261115. No forecasts changed or promoted.
limitations_known_before_results: Retrospective final-cutoff cohort, sources correlated through shared providers, posted quotes not transactions, missing quote attributes, collector updates and product availability inseparable from economic entry/exit, exact identity not unique causal decomposition, rounding in official target, source-specific panel construction, limited period, supplied backfilled or revised data do not prove historical publication availability.
